table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	demanddraftno = PurOrderHeader.demanddraftno,
	customername=(SELECT A.Name FROM Accounts A WHERE A.AccCode = PurOrderHeader.CustCode),
	amount=PurOrderHeader.Amount,
	customicode=item.customicode,
	supplierreference=PurOrderHeader.supplierreference,
	Dated = PurOrderHeader.Dated,
	itemname= item.name, 
	Packing = (SELECT IP.Name FROM ItemPacking IP WHERE IP.PackCode = Item.PackCode),
	location = item.location,
	PurOrderHeader.POCode,   
	PurOrderHeader.Date,   
	PurOrderDetail.ICode,   
	PurOrderDetail.Qty,   
	Accounts.Name,
	Address1 = S.Address1,
	Address2 = S.Address2,
	soldqty=PurOrderDetail.Soldqty,
	stock=PurOrderDetail.stock,
	rate=PurOrderDetail.rate,
	DiscPerc = PurOrderDetail.DiscPerc,
	DiscPerc2 = PurOrderDetail.DiscPerc2,
	PurOrderDetail.PORowID,
	Manufacturer=(select Manufacturer.name from Manufacturer where Manufacturer.manfcode=item.manfcode),
	startdate=PurOrderHeader.startdate,
	enddate=PurOrderHeader.enddate,
	projectiondays=PurOrderheader.Projectionperiod,
	purordercatcode=PurOrderHeader.purordercatcode,
	Remarks = PurOrderHeader.Remarks,
	Remarks2 = PurOrderHeader.Remarks2,
	Remarks3 = PurOrderHeader.Remarks3,
	PurOrderTerms1 = PurOrderHeader.PurOrderTerms1,
	PurOrderTerms2 = PurOrderHeader.PurOrderTerms2,
	PurOrderTerms3 = PurOrderHeader.PurOrderTerms3,
	PurOrderTerms4 = PurOrderHeader.PurOrderTerms4
FROM 
	PurOrderDetail,    
	PurOrderHeader,   
	Accounts, 
	Supplier S,
	item 
WHERE 
	( PurOrderHeader.POCode = PurOrderDetail.POCode ) and  
	( PurOrderDetail.icode = item.icode ) and  
	( PurOrderHeader.SuppCode = Accounts.AccCode ) and  
	( Accounts.AccCode = S.SuppCode ) AND
	( ( PurOrderHeader.POCode = :ra_POCode ) )    
ORDER BY
	manufacturer,
	itemname
/*
	PurOrderDetail.PORowID
	item.icatcode,
	item.packcode, 
	item.iccode
	I.manfcode, I.PackCode, I.IcatCode, I.Iccode
*/
